<script setup lang="ts">
import { storeToRefs } from "pinia";
import { useCounterStore } from "./store";

const store = useCounterStore();
const { count } = storeToRefs(store);
const increment = store.increment;
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="increment">{{ count }}</button>
</template>

warning.message:
Pinia stores should not be destructured directly

Help: Use storeToRefs(store) for state/getters and keep actions on the store object.

piniaStore:
import { defineStore } from "pinia";
export const useCounterStore = defineStore("counter", { state: () => ({ count: 0 }), actions: { increment() { this.count++; } } });
